Feb, 2026

2026 Player Evaluations



    


    

Evaluations start Saturday March 7th at:
 

Northmont Middle School 
810 National Rd, Clayton 45315

T-Ball (5-6 year old’s)      BASEBALL (BOYS) and SOFTBALL (GIRLS)

  • League age 5: No evaluation needed. Will placed on team.
  • League age 6: No evaluation needed. Will placed on team.
    • Optional: Any players (League age 6 only) may attend the player evaluations at the noted times in attempt to be evaluated and permitted to play up in the coach pitch division.  (Players must attend 2 of the 3 sessions)
      • Advancement to the Coach Pitch division is limited and will be based on skill level and roster availability.
      • Added Player fee of $40 will collected if selected. 

     

    Coach Pitch (7-8 year old’s)  BASEBALL (BOYS) and SOFTBALL (GIRLS)

  • League age 7: No evaluation needed. Will placed on team.
  • League age 8: No evaluation needed. Will placed on team.
    • Optional: Any players (League age 8 only) may attend the player evaluations at the noted times in their age group in attempt to be evaluated and permitted to play up in the Minors kid pitch division. (Players must attend 2 of the 3 sessions)
      • Advancement to the Kid Pitch division is limited and will be based on skill level and roster availability.

     

    Minors-Kid pitch (9-10 year old’s)       BASEBALL (BOYS) and SOFTBALL (GIRLS)

  • League age 9: Need to attend 2 of 3 sessions in their respective time slot.
  • League age 10: Need to attend 2 of 3 sessions in their respective time slot.
    • Optional: Any players (League age 10 only) wanting to possibly move up to the Majors division need to notify the player agent (at the sign in table at evaluation session) in attempt to be evaluated and permitted to play up in the Majors division.
      • Advancement to the Majors division is limited and will be based on skill level and roster availability.

     

    Majors (11-12 year old’s)    BASEBALL (BOYS) and SOFTBALL (GIRLS)

  • BASEBALL ONLY Players League age 11 or 12 who were on a Majors team in 2025 do not need to attend!
  • League age 11: Need to attend 2 of 3 sessions in their respective time slot.
  • League age 12: Need to attend 2 of 3 sessions in their respective time slot.

     

    Juniors (13-14 year old’s)  BASEBALL (BOYS) only      

  • League age 13: Need to attend 2 of 3 sessions in their respective time slot.
  • League age 14: Need to attend 2 of 3 sessions in their respective time slot.

 

 

Note: PLAYERS NOT ATTENDING 2 OF THE 3 SESSIONS WILL BE PLACED ON A TEAM (BLIND DRAW)
